# Scott & Scott LLP

> A specialized technology law firm providing expert legal counsel on software licensing, audits, compliance, and technology transactions.

Scott & Scott LLP is a boutique law firm focused on technology law with deep expertise in software licensing disputes, BSA compliance, audit defense, and emerging areas like AI and cloud services. The firm represents clients in negotiations, audits, and litigation involving major software publishers including Microsoft, Oracle, and IBM.

## Key Topics

- Software Licensing
- BSA Compliance
- Software Audit Defense
- Microsoft Audits
- Oracle Audits
- IBM Audits
- Contracts-as-a-Service
- Security & Privacy
- Data Breach Response
- Artificial Intelligence
- IT Services
- Technology Litigation
- License Compliance
- SaaS
- MSPs
